attributionNote.claim: AI shows up as a reason because companies say so when they announce cuts. The trackers (Challenger, Layoffs.fyi) record the reason the company gives; they do not check it.
attributionNote.counter: Some analysts read part of these cuts as restructuring for other reasons (over-hiring in 2021–22, costs, high interest rates) and argue that citing AI plays well with investors.
